description: This file defines an Android activity that demonstrates inflating menus from XML resources, handling menu item selections, and dynamically altering menu visibility. It includes UI elements like a spinner for selecting different menu XML examples, and shows how menus can be customized and managed programmatically.

classes.name: MenuInflateFromXml
classes.description: An Android activity that demonstrates inflating menus from XML resources, handling menu item selections, and dynamically managing menu visibility.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, creates the UI layout, and sets up the spinner for menu selection.

methods.name: onCreateOptionsMenu
methods.description: Inflates the selected menu XML resource into the activity's options menu; updates instructions.

methods.name: onOptionsItemSelected
methods.description: Handles menu item selections, showing toasts, toggling group visibility, and handling submenu interactions.
